notes.title: KOOK Dev Highlights #22
notes.content: [p]For those unaware, I live stream the development of KOOK on [url="https://twitch.tv/jitspoe" style="button"]twitch.tv/jitspoe[/url] [/p][p]I'm going through and making highlights of the development streams so you can see funny/interesting moments.
